turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: A vendor claim about scale and safety is not independent validation. NVIDIA says this. The partners say they're integrating. Whether it works as described in a live enterprise environment is a separate question.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: And that's the real continuity here — yesterday we had an unresolved argument about whether this would be a genuine security advance or expensive AI bureaucracy. Now we have the actual product.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: We do. And honestly, it moves the needle. Not because it solves the problem — it doesn't — but because doing governance at the hardware layer with identity verification is more than most enterprises have right now.
